1) Beneficiary / tax docs: attached is our W9 (W9-redwood.pdf). Beneficiary legal name is "Redwood Inference, Inc." and the EIN on the W9 will match for wire.

2) Payment routes (pick one):
   - ACH (preferred): No fee, nominal settlement time (1–2 business days). We'll provide ACH routing + last 4 account digits once you confirm ACH is acceptable.
   - Wire (fallback): Standard wire works; please confirm the beneficiary name must match exactly to release.
   - Virtual card: we can accept virtual card but there is a processing fee; not preferable for large invoices.

3) VAT: Redwood will not gross-up. We will issue a VAT invoice/credit note only if the transaction requires it under EU law; for US entities there is no VAT impact. If Wedgent needs a separate VAT document, tell us the remit entity and we will coordinate with finance.

Next step: please confirm preferred route (ACH or wire) and which legal entity to map the invoice to by EOD Wed 2026-08-12 so Ben and I can prioritize. If you choose wire, we will send a short wire-authorization stub for your AP to complete.

Best,
